name: com.cidonix.unibridge
description: Local MCP tools that let AI coding agents inspect, edit, capture, and validate Unity Editor projects through a per-project bridge and relay.

_upm.changelog:
### Fixed

- Relay MCP startup now waits for the client initialized notification before connecting to Unity, so no tools/list_changed notification can precede the initialize response.
- Tool-list notifications are emitted once per Unity connection generation, including reconnects, without startup duplicates.
- The legacy Unity adapter accepts concurrent relay clients so the configured agent connection and diagnostics no longer monopolize one named pipe.

### Previous Changes

- Serialized arrays and List values use recursive collection readback with stable Unity object identity.
- A dependency-free Unity 2017.4 compatibility adapter is available under Legacy~/Unity2017.
- BatchActions hierarchy references are no longer misclassified as filesystem paths.
